title: ZK-LinkHub
tagline: Unlock online potential with ZK email: Unique email, website, and collaboration tools for seamless digital experiences.
description:
We provide unique email, name service, and website using ZK email. This service has a similar concept to GitHub but offers various features to enhance your online experience.

ZK email provides you with individual email addresses. You can use these addresses to send and receive emails, and if necessary, exchange tokens for more secure communication. Additionally, you can use your email address to create various items such as portfolios, resumes, and diaries.

To manage your website, ZK email offers users various features. It provides tools to configure and design your website and offers statistical information about the website for performance observation. Furthermore, ZK email provides chat functionality and collaboration tools to facilitate communication between users.

Through this ZK-based email name service website, you can build your personal online presentation. Express yourself and communicate with others using your unique email address and website. We are continuously developing to meet customer demands and will provide new features and improved services in the future.

how_its_made:
P.S.E (Email 2FA Authentication):

We're excited to introduce our innovative approach to email 2FA authentication, leveraging cutting-edge technologies for enhanced security and user experience.

- Next.js for Frontend Development:
We've chosen Next.js for our frontend development, ensuring a smooth and responsive user interface that enhances user engagement and interaction.

- Smart Contract Development:
In our backend infrastructure, we've implemented smart contracts to facilitate secure and transparent transactions. These contracts enable seamless integration with our email 2FA authentication system.

- ZK Email Libraries for Email Verification:
For robust email verification, we've integrated zk-email libraries. These libraries, housed under zk-email/helpers, zk-email/contracts, and zk-email/circuits, employ zero-knowledge proof techniques to ensure confidentiality and authenticity in the verification process.

With our comprehensive approach to email 2FA authentication, we prioritize user security while maintaining a seamless and intuitive authentication experience. Thank you for choosing us for your authentication needs!

Scroll (Network integration):

The integration of the provided smart contract with Scroll involved adapting it for compatibility with Scroll's zero-knowledge rollup solution, zkEVM.

We optimized gas expenditures by leveraging Scroll's capabilities, starting with setting up our development environment with necessary tools. 

We then deployed refined smart contracts on Scroll's testnet for realistic testing without financial risk. 

This enabled us to assess transaction performance and efficiency compared to Ethereum execution, resulting in substantial gas fee reduction with zkEVM technology.
